answer: An copycat running 52 aliases hence needs 61 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in island, expire in nectar, and prism lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4674 identities would post 1681 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
